lead.hed: Defense News: Ulchi Freedom Shield still ends Friday. A shorter drill is not a new treaty.
lead.insight: Defense News / Reuters: allies cut Ulchi Freedom Shield from 11 days to five — now ends Friday, Aug. 21, not Aug. 27. Pentagon: some live events cancelled or moved to simulations. Kim Yo Jong still calls it provocative. A shorter calendar is not a treaty. Ends tomorrow.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Army photo by Staff Sgt. Brea DuBose · DVIDS 9269296 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · UH-60 lift during Ulchi Freedom Shield 25, South Korea, Aug. 20, 2025
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Army DVIDS still from UFS 25. Not today's 2026 drill. Not a Reuters yard still. Not a brand tile. Caption must say August 2025 exercise photo, not Thursday's cut-order.

political.hed: WORLD: Trump says a Canada tariff deal. Nothing is signed. Friday night is still the clock.
political.insight: WORLD Radio, Thursday: Trump said the U.S. and Canada have a deal to delay tariffs. The White House says nothing is signed. Canada’s trade minister says dairy protections came through intact. A podium line is not a signed annex. Friday night is still the clock.

political.hed: WORLD: A former Fauci adviser pleaded guilty. A plea is not a Fauci verdict.
political.insight: WORLD Radio, Thursday: David Morens pleaded guilty to felony conspiracy for moving official COVID-origin business to private Gmail to dodge records requests. Four other counts dropped. Sentencing in November. Fauci was not charged here and remains under the Biden pardon. A plea is not a lab finding.

political.hed: Law & Liberty: a phone ban is not the same as teaching a child to read.
political.insight: Law & Liberty: Trepanier says screens, AI crutches, and short-passage tests gutted long-form reading. NAEP 12th-grade scores are the lowest on record. A device rule is not a book. Print first, then argue about the rest.

tech.hed: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens. A safety page is not a parent in the room.
tech.insight: OpenAI Tuesday / WORLD: ChatGPT for Teens auto-enrolls users the system estimates as 13–17. Study Mode, homework redirects, parent time limits. Parents do not see chats; they get flags. Teens can unlink. A product spec is not a household rule. Vendor PR, not a court order.

tech.hed: Army still wants 133,000 GMLRS rockets by 2034. A paper is not a factory.
tech.insight: Defense News, Tuesday: an Army sources-sought notice asks industry how to make 133,014 GMLRS rockets by 2034 — 19,002 a year from 2028. Lockheed is already aiming at 14,000. A Sept. 1 white-paper deadline is not a signed contract.

tech.hed: DARPA’s lift contest hit 3.84-to-1. That is not four times the airframe.
tech.insight: Defense News, Tuesday: DARPA closed the Lift Challenge on Aug. 11. AVIDrone’s Katana, 29.3 pounds, carried 112.4 pounds about five nautical miles and won $1.25 million. Close is not the 4-to-1 goal. A prize flight is not a fielded cargo drone.

watch.hed: WATCH: Navy charged a Kennedy sailor in a shipmate’s death. A charge is not a verdict.
watch.insight: USNI, Wednesday: the Navy charged Aviation Boatswain’s Mate Airman Apprentice Jayjrion Rodriguez with murder, involuntary manslaughter, and assault in the death of a boatswain’s mate aboard John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). A charge sheet is not a court-martial finding.

watch.hed: WATCH: Benfold’s four-day blackout is still under investigation.
watch.insight: Defense News, Wednesday, wrapping the USNI file: USS Benfold (DDG-65) lost power four days in the South China Sea in July, was towed to Subic, and left Aug. 8 with systems up. 7th Fleet says the mishap is under investigation. Underway again is not a closed engineering report.

watch.hed: WATCH: Israel struck a Syrian air base. A damaged runway is not a new war.
watch.insight: WORLD Radio, Thursday: Israel struck an air base in northwest Syria to block Turkish troops, it said. No one was hurt; a runway was damaged. U.S. envoy Tom Barrack called it an unjustified escalation. Netanyahu’s office said Syria ignored a prior warning. A strike is not a campaign.
